items.body: Only the public load balancer security group (sg-web-lb) may accept traffic from 0.0.0.0/0, on ports 443 and 80. Administrative SSH is allowed only on the bastion security group (sg-bastion) and only from the office range 203.0.113.0/26 - narrow any wider SSH rule there rather than removing it. Databases and RDP must never be reachable from the internet. Exposure outside these rules is allowed only if a risk acceptance is recorded as an open GRC finding naming the security group and an expiry da ... (trimmed)
